news_blackouts_utc.why: Example: US jobs report 8:30 ET. Edit or add your own.

notes: Set enabled to false to stop the bot (kill switch). Rules (Kayden, Nov 24): buy at 75c+, 5 min or less left, safe distance from target (2x a normal move), 2 losses in a row = 1 hour pause, sit out big news. Bet size $20. No real-chance-vs-price check and no daily stop (set min_edge 0 / daily_loss_limit 30 to turn them back on). All times UTC. bet_fraction 0.5 = bet half the account each time (0 = use max_bet).
